items.name: ACA Cube Fest Baku 2026
items.information:
**ACA Cube Fest Baku 2026** kub həvəskarlarını bir araya gətirən ən enerjili və həyəcan dolu festival olacaq. Sürət, rəqabət, yeni dostluqlar və unudulmaz anlarla dolu bu atmosferin bir parçası olmaq üçün sən də bizə qoşul!
________

**ACA Cube Fest Baku 2026** will be one of the most exciting and energetic festivals bringing together cube enthusiasts. Join us and become part of an atmosphere filled with speed, competition, new friendships, and unforgettable moments!

venue.name: [Strathcona Community Center](http://www.strathcona.ca/departments/facility-services/community-centre/)
venue.address: 401 Festival Ln, Sherwood Park, AB T8A 5T8
venue.details: The room that will be used is the Agora

items.name: Mini-Sota Summer 2026
items.information:
### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Friday evening* 

##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host Clock, 4x4, and Megaminx solving.

[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota)
##### ____________________________________

Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space.

items.name: Texoma Sunrise 2026
items.information:
This competition takes place on a Friday morning.

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
